# LearnAI

> LearnAI (https://learnai.to) is a free, guided learning journey that takes complete beginners to genuine, demonstrable AI capability. It has five progressive levels and 50 short, hands-on lessons. Every lesson ends with a real task and a quick quiz; finishing a level earns a verifiable certificate. No signup or login is required.

Tagline: Learn useful AI skills. Then prove it.

LearnAI is for non-technical professionals and curious beginners who want practical, work-relevant AI skills — not theory. A short placement quiz routes each learner to the right starting level. Content is hand-authored and example-driven. The learning model follows the Literacy → Fluency → Mastery framework.

## Start here
- [LearnAI home — the journey map](https://learnai.to/): Overview of the five-level journey and your progress.
- [Placement quiz](https://learnai.to/placement): A 3-question quiz that recommends where to start.
- [About the curriculum team](https://learnai.to/about): How lessons are written, reviewed, and updated.

## The five levels
- [Level 1 — AI Foundations (Literacy)](https://learnai.to/track/fundamentals): Understand what AI is, what it can and can't do, and how to use it safely. about 90 minutes.
- [Level 2 — Prompt Engineering (Fluency)](https://learnai.to/track/prompting): Get reliable, high-quality results from any AI tool. No coding. about 90 minutes.
- [Level 3 — AI for Everyday Productivity (Fluency)](https://learnai.to/track/productivity): Use AI to get real work (and life) done faster. No technical background. about 2 hours.
- [Level 4 — AI Automation (Mastery)](https://learnai.to/track/automation): Connect tools and build workflows that run without you. Low/no code. about 2 hours.
- [Level 5 — Advanced & Specialized AI (Mastery)](https://learnai.to/track/building): Design, combine, and innovate: RAG, chatbots, data, coding, and teaching others. about 60 minutes.

## All lessons
### Level 1: AI Foundations
- [What AI Actually Is (and Is Not)](https://learnai.to/track/fundamentals/1): You'll be able to explain what AI is versus ML, deep learning, and generative AI in plain language.
- [How Large Language Models Work](https://learnai.to/track/fundamentals/2): You'll be able to explain how an LLM predicts text and why it hallucinates.
- [What AI Can and Cannot Do](https://learnai.to/track/fundamentals/3): You'll be able to sort work tasks into what AI handles well versus what needs a human.
- [Safe and Responsible AI Use](https://learnai.to/track/fundamentals/4): You'll be able to apply a safe-use checklist so you never leak sensitive data.
- [The AI Tools Landscape](https://learnai.to/track/fundamentals/5): You'll be able to pick the right category of AI tool for a given task.
- [AI Ethics and Bias Awareness](https://learnai.to/track/fundamentals/6): You'll be able to spot bias signals in AI output and explain their likely cause.
- [AI and Your Job](https://learnai.to/track/fundamentals/7): You'll be able to map your job tasks into automate, assist, and human-only.
- [Generative AI vs. Traditional Software](https://learnai.to/track/fundamentals/8): You'll be able to explain why the same prompt can return different answers.
- [The Human-in-the-Loop Mindset](https://learnai.to/track/fundamentals/9): You'll be able to define your personal verification habit for AI output.
- [Speaking the Language of AI](https://learnai.to/track/fundamentals/10): You'll be able to use core AI terms correctly in a conversation.

### Level 2: Prompt Engineering
- [Prompt Engineering Fundamentals](https://learnai.to/track/prompting/1): You'll be able to write prompts with context, instructions, input, and output format.
- [Role-Playing and Persona Prompting](https://learnai.to/track/prompting/2): You'll be able to use a persona to raise the quality of the output.
- [Few-Shot and Example-Based Prompting](https://learnai.to/track/prompting/3): You'll be able to teach the AI a format with examples for consistent output.
- [Chain-of-Thought Prompting](https://learnai.to/track/prompting/4): You'll be able to use step-by-step reasoning to improve accuracy.
- [Iterative and Multi-Turn Prompting](https://learnai.to/track/prompting/5): You'll be able to reach a polished result by refining across turns.
- [Prompt Templates and Libraries](https://learnai.to/track/prompting/6): You'll be able to build a saved library of reusable prompts.
- [Controlling Tone, Style, and Format](https://learnai.to/track/prompting/7): You'll be able to produce the same content in multiple formats and tones.
- [Diagnosing and Fixing Bad Outputs](https://learnai.to/track/prompting/8): You'll be able to diagnose which part of a prompt failed and fix it.
- [System Prompts, Temperature, and Context](https://learnai.to/track/prompting/9): You'll be able to configure a system prompt and temperature for a use case.
- [Prompting for Different Work Domains](https://learnai.to/track/prompting/10): You'll be able to write an effective prompt for a task outside your usual role.

### Level 3: AI for Everyday Productivity
- [AI Writing: Drafting, Editing, Tone](https://learnai.to/track/productivity/1): You'll be able to turn rough notes into a polished email, summary, and one-pager fast.
- [AI Research and Summarization](https://learnai.to/track/productivity/2): You'll be able to summarize a long document into key findings and actions.
- [AI for Email and Communication](https://learnai.to/track/productivity/3): You'll be able to set up a reusable email workflow from a few bullets.
- [AI for Meeting Prep and Follow-Up](https://learnai.to/track/productivity/4): You'll be able to turn a transcript into decisions, action items, and owners.
- [AI for Brainstorming and Ideation](https://learnai.to/track/productivity/5): You'll be able to run a structured brainstorm and select the best ideas.
- [AI for Planning and Project Management](https://learnai.to/track/productivity/6): You'll be able to turn a vague goal into a milestone plan with risks.
- [AI for Summarizing and Analyzing Data](https://learnai.to/track/productivity/7): You'll be able to get insights from a spreadsheet without writing a formula.
- [AI for Learning and Development](https://learnai.to/track/productivity/8): You'll be able to use AI as a tutor pitched at the right level for you.
- [AI for Content: Posts, Slides, Visuals](https://learnai.to/track/productivity/9): You'll be able to produce aligned content across formats from one topic.
- [AI for Personal Finance and Decisions](https://learnai.to/track/productivity/10): You'll be able to summarize the key terms and risks in a real document.
- [AI for Job Search and Career](https://learnai.to/track/productivity/11): You'll be able to tailor a resume and run a mock interview with feedback.
- [Building a Personal AI Workflow System](https://learnai.to/track/productivity/12): You'll be able to describe your personal AI system: tools, prompts, verification.
- [AI for Health, Wellness, and Goals](https://learnai.to/track/productivity/13): You'll be able to design a personalized 30-day plan with safe verification.

### Level 4: AI Automation
- [What Automation Is and When to Use It](https://learnai.to/track/automation/1): You'll be able to classify a task as automate now, use AI manually, or keep human.
- [APIs and How Data Moves Between Tools](https://learnai.to/track/automation/2): You'll be able to explain in plain words how a trigger moves data between apps.
- [No-Code Automation with Zapier or Make](https://learnai.to/track/automation/3): You'll be able to build a trigger to action to result workflow.
- [n8n for Intermediate Automation](https://learnai.to/track/automation/4): You'll be able to build a branching workflow with error handling.
- [Connecting AI to Your Workflows](https://learnai.to/track/automation/5): You'll be able to add an AI judgment step inside an automation.
- [Spotting Automatable Tasks at Work](https://learnai.to/track/automation/6): You'll be able to audit your week and write an automation spec.
- [Build a Lead Capture / Intake Automation](https://learnai.to/track/automation/7): You'll be able to build an end-to-end intake automation.
- [Build an AI-Powered Content Workflow](https://learnai.to/track/automation/8): You'll be able to build a content workflow with a human review checkpoint.
- [Guardrails and Human Checkpoints](https://learnai.to/track/automation/9): You'll be able to add safety checks that prevent specific failures.
- [Scheduling, Monitoring, Maintaining](https://learnai.to/track/automation/10): You'll be able to schedule, monitor, and fix a broken automation.
- [Building a Personal AI Agent (No-Code)](https://learnai.to/track/automation/11): You'll be able to build a no-code agent that completes a multi-step task.

### Level 5: Advanced & Specialized AI
- [RAG: Retrieval-Augmented Generation](https://learnai.to/track/building/1): You'll be able to explain how RAG grounds AI in your own data.
- [No-Code AI Chatbots and Assistants](https://learnai.to/track/building/2): You'll be able to plan a chatbot connected to a document source.
- [AI for Data Analysis (Intermediate)](https://learnai.to/track/building/3): You'll be able to run an AI-assisted analysis and produce a findings brief.
- [AI for Coding and Vibe Coding](https://learnai.to/track/building/4): You'll be able to build a working tool from a plain-language description.
- [Teaching AI to Others](https://learnai.to/track/building/5): You'll be able to teach a beginner to complete one useful AI task.
- [Your Long-Term AI Learning System](https://learnai.to/track/building/6): You'll be able to set up a self-renewing AI learning habit.

## Key facts
- Cost: Free. No account or email required.
- Format: 50 micro-lessons (about 2-4 minutes each) across 5 levels.
- Assessment: An auto-graded quiz (pass at 80%) plus a hands-on task per lesson.
- Credential: A shareable, publicly verifiable certificate per level.
- Topics covered include: prompt engineering, AI agents, no-code automation (Zapier, Make, n8n), APIs, RAG, and the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
